MAKERWORLD LISTING: IMAGE KEYCHAIN MAKER
==============================================================
Copy each section into the matching field of the MakerWorld upload form.
Upload steps are in makerworld/README.md.


MODEL NAME
--------------------------------------------------------------
Image Keychain Maker - Your Picture + Name, Multicolor (Customizable)


SUMMARY (short description, if the form asks for one)
--------------------------------------------------------------
Upload any logo or drawing and get a multicolor keychain with your text, an outline border and a keyring hole. Ready for AMS.


CATEGORY (pick the closest one in the dropdown)
--------------------------------------------------------------
First choice: Fashion > Accessories (or Keychains, if listed)
Second choice: Hobby & DIY


TAGS
--------------------------------------------------------------
keychain, customizable, parametric, multicolor, AMS, name tag, logo, image to keychain, gift, openscad


LICENSE (your choice; suggestion)
--------------------------------------------------------------
Suggested: Creative Commons BY-NC-SA (people may share and remix with credit, but not sell).
Pick "Standard Digital File License" instead if you don't want remixes shared.


DESCRIPTION (paste everything between the lines)
--------------------------------------------------------------
Turn your own picture into a multicolor keychain in a few clicks. Press "Customize", upload a PNG or SVG, type a name, pick your colors and download a 3MF that is ready for the AMS.

WHAT YOU GET
- Up to 4 picture colors, taken from your PNG automatically
- Optional text above or below the picture, with any Google font
- Raised outline border in its own color
- Base plate that follows the shape of your picture, with a keyring hole
- Every color is a separate part, so each one gets its own filament

HOW TO USE
1. Click "Customize" (Parametric Model Maker).
2. In the "Picture" tab, upload your image. A PNG with a plain WHITE background works best. Crop it tightly around the logo.
3. Set "color_count" to how many colors your logo has (not counting the white background).
4. Open the "Picture colors" tab and pick the filament color for each one. Color 1 is the darkest part of your picture, color 4 the lightest.
5. Add your text, choose a font and turn the border on or off.
6. Click Generate, check the preview, and download the 3MF.

TIPS FOR GOOD RESULTS
- Colors are separated by brightness (dark to light). Logos with clearly different light and dark colors work best. Two colors with the same brightness (for example a medium red and a medium green) end up as one color.
- If a color lands in the wrong group, move the "cut_1" to "cut_4" sliders (0 = black, 100 = white). cut_1 splits color 1 from color 2, cut_2 splits color 2 from color 3, and so on.
- Transparent PNGs: transparent areas count as black. Save your picture on a white background first.
- White parts of your picture are not printed in color; the base shows through, so a white base makes them white.
- Lines thinner than "min_detail" are removed so they print cleanly. Make the picture bigger to keep more detail.
- SVG files are printed in one color (color 1).
- Very large pictures (thousands of pixels) are slow. About 300 to 600 pixels tall is plenty.

PRINT SETTINGS
- 0.4 mm nozzle, 0.2 mm layer height (0.12 to 0.16 mm for small text)
- PLA, no supports, print flat as generated
- 2 walls, 15% infill
- Default size: about 44 x 64 mm, 2.6 mm thick, about 6 g of filament

SINGLE-COLOR PRINTER?
Make every raised color the same (picture colors, text color and border color), then add a filament change (pause) at the top of the base (2.0 mm by default). You get a two-color keychain without an AMS.

FULL VERSION
There is also a free web app with automatic color detection by hue (not just brightness), a 2D/3D preview and direct 3MF export:
https://github.com/clarkstyx/image-keychain-modeler
--------------------------------------------------------------


PRINT PROFILE NOTES (for the "print profile" step)
--------------------------------------------------------------
- Printer: any Bambu Lab printer with AMS (or another multi-material setup)
- Plate: 1 keychain, centered, flat side down
- Filaments: base (white), black, green, gold in the sample; the customer's colors replace them
- MakerWorld requires at least one PHOTO OF A REAL PRINT. Print makerworld/sample-keychain.3mf and take a photo before publishing.
- The preview-iso.png and preview-top.png renders can be added as extra pictures.


BILL OF MATERIALS
--------------------------------------------------------------
- Filament: about 6 g of PLA in total (mostly the base color)
- Keyring: 25 mm split ring or a ball chain, through the 5 mm hole
